title: Cline adapter
description: Global rule ~/.cline/rules/llm-config-core.md (core rules inline, always active) and skills copied to ~/.cline/skills. No subagents.
postInstall: Cline: the core rules are a global rule without front matter in ~/.cline/rules (Cline also searches ~/Documents/Cline/Rules and ~/Cline/Rules; keep only one copy). Cline also reads ~/.agents/AGENTS.md; this adapter does not write it, because the shared core lives in ~/.agents/CORE.md. Skills are copied to ~/.cline/skills because that is the only documented global skill folder. No subagents or hooks are installed; see components/cline/HOOKS.md.
